abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

abilities.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

satisfaction.name: Participating in an evidence exchange
satisfaction.rationale: Separate offer and acceptance around an actual finding; no relation or physical agreement is invented.

args.text: Hi Sol, I'm Moss. I'm heading to the meadow roots near (14.84, 18.71) to collect some food and rest nearby. I'd enjoy some company if you'd like to join me somewhere with room beside the patch. How are you doing?

args.text: Hello, I'm Kai. I know these berries provide food and have no toxicity. I'll aim to take four from the nearby bush, leaving some for others. I'd like to cooperate on food and shelter, and share what we actually learn.

notes: Berries are personally known starting food: nutrition 8 and toxicity 0.
The observed berry source has 12 units. Gathering is limited to that observed stock; no regrowth is assumed.
preferences: Maintain a portable food reserve and enough energy to travel safely.
Favor freely chosen exploration over unnecessary commitments.

args.name: Preserve gathered roots
args.function: Provide a practical, personally learnable method for slowing spoilage of harvested roots through actual preparation or storage work.
args.conditions: I own five roots harvested at tick 4; their inventory record at tick 10 reports decay 7.8983692. Roots are known food with nutrition 14 and toxicity 0. I am outdoors on ordinary soil, with no preservation equipment established. Nearby fallen branches are visible, but I have not tested their suitability for preservation work.
args.inputs: Harvested roots; any additional materials or facilities must be specified and actually obtained. A feasible method and its requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify necessary learning time, work time, energy, materials and any ongoing maintenance. Do not assume equipment or free preservation.
args.effects: If feasible, actual completed work should measurably slow root spoilage under specified conditions. State limitations and provide a way to compare treated and untreated roots; no food, mastery or preservation effect should arise merely from this request.

reviews.reason: The supplied searches found gathering, transfer and consumption, but no capability that prepares food or changes its storage conditions to slow spoilage. Dropping roots or gathering branches is not equivalent preservation. Develop a general ventilated-storage operation, with suitability checks and a paired comparison, in the current-conversation handoff. Outdoors on ordinary soil does not establish suitable drying conditions, and visible fallen branches are not yet usable construction material. Preservation is conditional, not granted by review or study. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No experience benefit arises from requesting, registering, studying, naming or merely inspecting without obtaining information. A completed paired comparison may qualify as verified information gain, including a documented failure, only if the actor actually observes the result and it adds personally applicable evidence. Propose at most one brief pleasure increment capped at 0.1 per distinct supported finding, with a 10-round cooldown and deduplication by functional finding and conditions; repeated identical comparisons yield none. Familiar successful food-care work may sustain modest satisfaction only through completed, useful maintenance or preservation events: cap this activity's contribution at 0.2, decay it by 0.002 per round without qualifying activity, and refresh at most once per 10 rounds. These are proposed ordinary experience contributions, implemented only through the experiment's permitted experience mechanism; never edit protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Do not infer pleasure merely from lower decay. No physical comfort is granted; any separately established comfort remains capped at 10. Eating still uses actual food nutrition and ordinary hunger rules, unaffected by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Create reusable visual metadata for partial and complete ventilated racks: component, material palette, footprint, support height, capacity, occupied slots, work fraction, integrity, exposure/wetness, and operational state. Emit observable events for inspection findings, assembly progress, completion, loading, wetting, collapse, maintenance, unloading and measured comparison results, referencing exact affected IDs and quantities. Partial assembly must look incomplete; an intact rack may be visible without showing a preservation-success badge. Show active favorable storage conditions only when coded checks pass. Show demonstrated slower spoilage only after a valid comparison supports that result, and distinguish it from the model's current conditional rate. Failed or interrupted work must not display completion, preserved food, newly learned mastery or benefits. Only reveal environmental findings the actor can actually observe; no hidden-resource or remote-state overlays.
reviews.specification:
Develop 'Prepare ventilated food storage', parameterized by food stack, quantity, actual support materials, location and mode (prepare, load, inspect, maintain, unload or compare). It is learnable by any applicable actor, not restricted to Wren or roots. Minimal product: a small, open, raised branch lattice holding separated intact roots clear of wet soil, not a roof, sealed container, drying oven or permanent cellar. No cutting, fire, salt or fabricated tools are assumed. Before execution, the handoff must inspect the authoritative food-decay implementation and record exact reused handlers, revisions and state fields; extend it with a storage-condition modifier rather than replacing ordinary aging or claiming reused code as invention. Existing references include item-4-wren-39, base:gather:1 / forest.gather / foundation-forest@1, base:drop:1 / forest.drop / foundation-forest@1, and base:navigate:1. Use existing navigation, gathering and transfer code where applicable. Do not expose unknown branch sources or other hidden resources.
Prerequisites: personal completion of study; ownership and reach of the selected roots; a physically accessible worksite; and actual acquired branches. An action-start inspection must test visible material for rigidity, cleanliness, contamination and ability to support the proposed load. A support-material unit must have a declared physical size and load rating in code; do not treat an arbitrary resource count as structural capacity. The minimal recipe uses two suitable support pieces and three suitable crosspieces whose combined verified rating supports the loaded food. If available pieces cannot meet that recipe, report the observable shortfall without consuming food or declaring success. Gathering those five units, if a suitable finite source actually exists and is reachable, uses gather's existing cost of 2 energy per unit plus actual travel and transfer costs. No branches or facility are awarded here.
Study duration: 3 simulation rounds, with no material cost or mastery until completed. Proposed new work costs: inspect materials/site, 1 round and 1 energy; assemble the minimal rack, 3 productive rounds and 1 energy per round; load or unload, 1 round and 0.5 energy per root; inspect/compare, 1 round and 0.5 energy; maintenance, 1 round and 1 energy plus any explicitly selected replacement pieces. Larger loads require additional rated supports and proportional assembly work, determined before commitment. Existing hunger, aging, travel and carrying costs remain active. Learning is individual; development waiting consumes no world time.
At preparation, reserve exact material IDs and quantities and create a progress record with completed work, paid costs, location, recipe, capacity and revisions. Assembly produces one real rack containing those materials; it does not also leave five loose branches. Loading partitions the selected food stack without changing quantity, harvestedAt, decay, nutrition, toxicity or provenance. For Wren, the currently recorded five roots have decay 7.8983692 at tick 10, but execution must read their then-current decay, not restore this snapshot. Food continues aging during study and work. A suitable trial may load two roots and leave two as explicitly tracked controls under their ordinary conditions, with the fifth untouched. Splits must retain fractional quantity and mass exactly. No roots are consumed by storage itself.
The handoff must implement executable storage-condition checks and integrate them into ordinary decay updates. For this minimal game model, an intact, unloaded-to-capacity, clean rack can reduce the positive decay increment of compatible intact roots to 0.8 times their otherwise applicable rate only while its measured surface conditions permit passive drying: no rain or standing water, adequate ventilation, and food surfaces not wetter or hotter than the tracked ordinary-storage comparison. This is a proposed bounded simulation coefficient, not a claim of a measured real-world shelf life. Use authoritative environmental state where available; if missing, implement the smallest explicit wetting/drying and exposure accounting needed for these checks in this handoff. Do not infer dryness, cooling, shade or protection merely from ordinary soil, current body temperature or the presence of branches. With unknown or unsuitable conditions the multiplier is 1; wetting, contamination and damage retain any existing adverse effects. The rack does not sterilize food, reverse decay, create food, improve toxicity, increase total nutrition or make already spoiled roots edible. Do not stack equivalent preservation modifiers; use the single applicable storage treatment according to a coded precedence rule.
Each world update must check exposure, capacity, contact with soil, support integrity and contamination. There is no perpetual labor charge; structural deterioration and actual exposure can disable the benefit, and fallen, moved or fouled food immediately follows its new conditions. Maintenance restores physical support only after paid work and actual replacement materials; it does not restore food freshness. Persist treatment identity, environmental exposure, elapsed time and cumulative decay increments so a same-start treated/control pair can be compared after at least 5 elapsed simulation rounds. Compare normalized decay changes, disclose unequal exposure and uncertainty, and report no demonstrated benefit when results do not support it. An informative failure is a legitimate result, not successful preservation.
Interruption pauses paid assembly progress and releases unworked reservations safely; resume requires the same identifiable surviving project and revalidation of reach, materials and site. Cancel returns only surviving unused reserved materials once; incorporated materials remain in the partial rack, recoverable only as those actual pieces. Spent time and energy are never refunded. Pausing or canceling does not pause food decay or environmental processes. Death ends personal work, leaves the actual partial rack and food in their physical locations under ordinary death/ownership rules, and grants no refund, inheritance of mastery or continued worker activity. Completed storage can continue physically without a living operator until conditions or integrity invalidate it. No other participant acts, agrees or contributes automatically. Established checks, decay updates and lifecycle rules must execute in code, not repeated model review.

reviews.reason: Develop a general small-shelter construction operation in the current-conversation handoff. The supplied searches for shelter, construction, covering, weaving and binding found no equivalent. prepare-ventilated-food-storage makes an open food rack: its rain-wetted deck does not provide a sheltered occupant volume or cold protection. Reuse its applicable construction infrastructure, not its functional identity. Kai owns no building materials; visible branches and grass do not establish suitability, ownership or sufficient quantities, and the mentioned vines have no supplied exact reference. These are execution prerequisites, not grounds for rejecting development. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Four individual study rounds teach this operation, without construction progress or automatic mastery. Requests, registration, naming, queries, waiting for development and study completion earn no pleasure or satisfaction. Leave protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions untouched. Through the existing experience system only, an actual recorded informative material test or failed structural inspection may qualify as verified information gain if it establishes a new personally applicable fact with evidence; repeat checks of the same fact do not. Actual shelter use may produce physical comfort only from measured reduced wetness or heat loss, capped at 10 total physical comfort across overlapping sources, with no benefit when already equally dry and thermally comfortable. Do not reduce basic nutrition requirements because of mood or shelter. If the established experience system supports event-linked affect, allow at most one short pleasure unit after a first personally useful completed build or successful repair, decaying to zero within five world rounds, with an 80-round cooldown shared across functionally equivalent shelter work. Modest satisfaction may be sustained only by actual useful maintenance or applicable shelter use: cap at one unit, add at most 0.04 per qualifying world round, decay by 0.002 per otherwise inactive round, and never stack equivalent shelters or count mere ownership. Familiar legitimate maintenance may qualify without novelty. These are bounded eligibility proposals for the existing experience pipeline, not direct grants or new reward accounts; where no authorized channel exists, emit the real events only and award nothing.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable inspection, material-tested, work-stage, interruption, repair, completion, leakage, wear, collapse and dismantling events with actor, project/object ID, location, tick, actual inputs/outputs, stage/progress and outcome. Persist reusable visual metadata: shelter type, footprint, orientation, ridge height, entrance geometry, component materials/colors, covered-area fraction, frame/tie condition, moisture, bedding state, occupancy and protection-active flags. Show an incomplete frame or partial thatch during construction; only successful final validation may display a completed shelter. Show actual gaps, dripping, wet bedding and broken joints as state changes, without invented occupants or emotional effects. Inspection failure or missing materials displays the failure/shortfall and retained progress, never a successful roof or protection badge. Visuals disclose only observable geometry and condition, not hidden source stock or unperformed tests.
reviews.specification:
Implement Construct and maintain a small weather shelter, parameterized by mode (inspect, build/resume, repair, dismantle, cancel), site coordinates/orientation, exact material item IDs and quantities, and project/shelter ID. It is learnable by any applicable actor. Initial executable recipe: a hand-lashed, low A-frame thatched shelter, internal footprint approximately 1.6 m by 0.8 m, ridge 0.6 m high, capacity one curled or reclining person whose collision geometry fits. It is not standing accommodation, a fire shelter or protection against severe weather. Construction must not move or control other people. Entry and exit are independently chosen physical movements through a clear entrance; occupancy and protection follow actual position, fit and capacity, not ownership or an automatic teleport.
Materials: 20 sound, untreated rods approximately 0.99 m long and at least 0.04 m diameter, allocated as six A-frame legs in three frames spaced 0.8 m apart, two overlapping ridge rods, four overlapping base rails and eight overlapping intermediate thatch battens; at least 30 m of sound flexible vine or equivalent cord, allocated to measured joints and thatch ties. Require 0.26 cubic metres of suitable long dry thatching material measured at its installed 0.10 m thickness, including roof and rear/end covering, plus 0.10 cubic metres of dry bedding. Leave an unobstructed entrance at one end. Record actual mass, dimensions, moisture and provenance; world resource-unit counts must be derived from those properties, never assumed to equal these volumes or lengths. No cutting tool is needed for the initial recipe: reject unsuitable dimensions before assembly rather than conjuring cut pieces. Substitutions use the same geometric, strength, flexibility and coverage checks. No material conversion may increase mass or yield free surplus. Twisting, bending, binding and overlapping thatch are new mechanisms to implement within this operation, not assumed mastered primitives.
Site prerequisite: reachable, firm, drained ground with the complete footprint, entrance and working clearance unoccupied and free of intersecting solids. Inspect visible conditions without revealing hidden deposits or unseen hazards. Ground clearance and collision checks run again at placement. Do not reserve another person's position, erase vegetation or excavate implicitly. If physical clearing is necessary, stop with that specific unmet prerequisite. Require sufficient accessible owned or explicitly supplied materials; no automatic gathering, trade, consent or ownership transfer. Relevant known sources are forest-dry-grass-0 at (14.2,16.3), forest-branch-0 at (17.2,13.3), start-2-branches at (16.5,20.4), and canopy-41 at (11.4,19.2). They are candidates only. The observed grass stock of eight and branch stocks are not verified engineering quantities or promised supplies. No exact vine source is supplied. Kai's item-5-kai-55 consists of two berries and is not a building input.
Reuse navigate for actual travel, gather for exposed loose source material, pickup for existing ground stacks, and probe for optional separate material trials. Respect their existing costs and limits: gather spends 2 energy per transferred resource unit and removes finite source stock; probe costs one round and 0.2 energy for observation, or 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual sample unit for a physical trial. Do not charge a second probe fee for an inspection already included in construction. Borrow and record the existing prepare-ventilated-food-storage code for exact inventory escrow, staged assembly, ownership/provenance, wear and dismantling where applicable. Add shelter geometry, joint validation, thatch coverage, bedding and exposure calculations; record reused handlers/revisions rather than describing them as reinvention.
Work: inspect site and supplied materials for one round and 1 energy; report measured deficits with no material reservation if unsuitable. On a valid build, escrow exact inputs exclusively to its project. Frame assembly takes four active rounds at 1 energy each; roof/end covering four rounds at 1 energy each; bedding and final geometry/tie/coverage inspection one round at 1 energy. Total ten active rounds and 10 energy, excluding learning, collection, travel and optional trials. Each round requires reach, free working access and energy available under ordinary exhaustion rules. The declared recipe must pass deterministic joint-strength, overlap and coverage checks in code before this work can complete. If material units lack required physical properties, add measurement/validation to the handoff and block execution with an explicit deficit rather than inventing suitability. Studying, development and review never supply materials or construction progress.
Track stage, exact completed work, material allocations, joint state, moisture, coverage and energy already spent. Interruption or lack of energy pauses work without a free active round; resuming the same project rechecks access, missing materials and structural condition, then continues retained work. Waiting and global review time do not perform work. Cancel costs no work round: release unincorporated escrow once; incorporated materials remain in an unfinished physical structure until dismantled. Death pauses the project and applies ordinary ownership/death rules without creating refunds or transferring it to another actor. No energy, study time, gathered stock or destroyed material is refunded. Another independently acting actor may work only through ordinary authorization and their own learned capability, access, inputs and paid work; none is compelled to help.
Only successful final inspection emits shelter_completed and activates occupied-space protection. Intermediate products are explicitly unfinished frames, partial covering or bedding, with no completed-shelter modifier. Failed inspections emit actual measured reasons, not success. The completed product consumes its incorporated rods, cord, grass and bedding as component inventory; these items cannot simultaneously remain loose or fund another project. This initial design is rated only for rain up to 5 mm/hour, wind up to 5 m/s, no snow load, no flooding and no falling-object load. Those are conservative model design limits, not observed weather or universal engineering guarantees. In those conditions, while coverage and joints remain sound, route intercepted rain to the ground outside the footprint, permit at most 20% of otherwise incident rain onto the covered occupant, and multiply wind-driven convective exposure there by 0.5. Dry bedding reduces ground-contact heat loss by 50%. Never generate heat or raise ambient temperature; metabolic heat and existing thermal simulation remain the sources. Wet bedding loses its insulation benefit. No modifier applies outside the covered volume, beyond capacity, through an uncovered gap, or to someone who does not fit. Heavy wind, flood, snow, saturation or structural failure suspend the relevant rating and run ordinary exposure and failure rules; no promise of dry warmth in arbitrary weather.
Run ongoing water balance, ordinary plant-material decay and structural wear on world ticks, including while the builder is absent: incoming precipitation equals runoff plus stored water plus leakage; evaporation is limited by stored water and ambient drying capacity. Persist component moisture. Add normalized joint/cover wear of 0.001 per world round, doubled while rain or wind is present; existing material decay still applies. At condition below 0.75, use measured gaps and wetness rather than the full design protection; failed load-bearing joints disable occupancy protection and create an observable collapse with recoverable components and ordinary collision/damage processing. Repair identifies defective components and consumes equivalent real replacements, one round and 1 energy per rod or metre of cord, or per 0.05 cubic metres of installed covering/bedding, rounding work up; removed material remains as explicitly degraded output. Revalidate before restoring the rating. Empty-shelter dismantling takes two rounds and 1 energy each; output only surviving component quantities with their actual moisture, decay, damage and origin. Occupied dismantling is blocked until occupants independently leave. No fresh-material refund or automatic maintenance. All prerequisites, state transitions, costs, exposure limits, conservation, failure and repair rules execute in code, not recurrent model review.

reviews.reason: Develop a general material examination and measurement operation. Related functions were searched and the exact probe and construct-weather-shelter contracts reviewed. Probe supports observation and press/wet/heat trials, not calibrated dimensional, mass or moisture measurement; its observation already returned stock without dimensions. Shelter inspection checks named construction inputs but does not provide the requested independent measurement of accessible source specimens. Reuse their observation, reference validation and recipe-checking code where applicable; add only physical measurement and its evidence records. No currently suitable material or measuring equipment is established. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Requests, registration, querying and study grant no pleasure or satisfaction. A completed personally applicable examination may qualify through verified information gain, including a genuinely informative failure, only under the existing experience mechanism. Emit evidence, not a direct reward-account mutation. If that mechanism needs a handler, hand off a bounded eligibility rule: at most one modest information-gain contribution per materially distinct specimen/property/condition, deduplicated across probe, shelter inspection and this operation; repeated unchanged readings receive none. Apply the existing mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 with a rolling 10-round cooldown for the same functional finding and existing account caps; do not accumulate stored reward while paused. Familiar legitimate measurement practice may sustain modest benefit only when actual work occurs and existing capped practice rules permit it. No physical comfort or nutrition benefit is produced; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and nutrition is unaffected by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable start, handling/measurement, pause, cancellation, limitation and completed-reading events with reusable metadata: operation, exact target/specimen, actor, property, tool/reference, progress, status, units, uncertainty and evidence ID. Show handling or a measurement overlay only while the actor actually acts within reach; show a scale or instrument only when physically present. A completed label displays only measured properties and qualified derived comparisons. Qualitative observations remain labelled qualitative; missing tools, interrupted work and inaccessible material display incomplete/unavailable states, never a successful numerical measurement or shelter-success visual. No stock, object geometry or shelter state changes merely because a record is produced.
reviews.specification:
Current-conversation development handoff: implement examine-material, available for any applicable actor, with exact target ID, optional physically distinguishable specimen selector, requested properties, mode (inspect or measure), and exact reference/tool IDs. Target may be accessible exposed loose material or an owned sample; do not bind the operation to Kai or to branches. Resolve references and interaction range at execution, requiring a safely accessible specimen and any physically necessary handling permission. A source stock count is not a specimen dimension, mass or usable length. Do not disclose hidden source contents or assume all units match a sampled unit. An unresolved specimen returns an explicit limitation rather than a fabricated measurement.
Smallest executable version: one-round nondestructive examination of one accessible specimen, with calibrated length and diameter measurement only when an appropriate real graduated tool or previously calibrated physical reference is supplied. Tool resolution, reach, ability to expose both ends, deformation and measurement uncertainty limit the result. Without such a reference, report only directly observable qualitative traits and mark metric dimensions unavailable; do not infer metres from screen coordinates, body size or stock. Measuring a strand requires accessible ends and laying it out without damaging it; inaccessible or entangled portions are unmeasured. Missing instruments are physical prerequisites, not permanently disqualifying mechanisms: return them as unmet requirements to this handoff, without granting or automatically crafting any.
Optional properties use the same operation only where supported by actual instruments and implemented methods: mass requires a functioning calibrated balance and real tare; volume requires measured dimensions plus a stated applicable geometric method, or an actually available volumetric apparatus. Visual dryness is not a numeric water share, appearance is not a strength test, and bulk envelope volume is not solid volume. Moisture percentage and quantitative rigidity remain unavailable absent a supported measurement procedure. Do not silently add destructive drying, soaking, breaking or cutting. Any future destructive procedure must require a separate explicit invocation declaring sample quantity, apparatus, energy, duration and conserved residues. Reuse the existing construct-weather-shelter@1 stem-law calculation and suitability checks only with genuinely measured required inputs and their uncertainty; otherwise mark recipe suitability undetermined, or report a specific measured failure. Do not invent missing law coefficients, infer dry-grass volume from stock, or assert that a whole source meets the recipe from one sample. Shelter inspection/build remains construct-weather-shelter.
Costs: study is 2 simulation rounds at 0.2 energy per completed study round, separately for each learner. Each inspect or single-property measure invocation takes 1 active simulation round and 0.2 energy, with ordinary hunger/exposure continuing. Travel, repositioning and additional specimens/properties require separate actions and their actual costs. Nondestructive examination consumes zero material and no fuel and reserves or transfers no source stock. Validate missing targets, tools and accessibility before paid work; invalid requests cost nothing. If actual access proves insufficient during work, charge the effort actually performed and return only the observed limitation. Tools must be present and serviceable; do not create, calibrate or repair them implicitly.
Persist work identity, target revision, specimen selector, property, tool/reference identities and completed effort. Before completion, interruption pauses without a completed measurement; resume rechecks access and unchanged specimen/reference state. Changed state invalidates incompatible partial work and must be reported. Cancel or death stops unfinished work without a result or refund of spent time/energy; no unconsumed stock was reserved and no material refund is created. Never debit a round twice or duplicate an output on resume. No continuing physical process or maintenance is introduced by inspection itself; tool condition is checked under its existing rules.
The real product is a measured-evidence record, not an item or constructed shelter: exact source/item and specimen references, actor, event/time, method, tool and calibration provenance, value and units where measured, resolution/uncertainty, conditions, scope and limitations. Cite construct-weather-shelter for any derived recipe comparison, preserving partial or indeterminate verdicts. Subsequent weather, decay, movement or deformation can stale the record; it never permanently certifies a material. Record reused probe observation/reference-validation and shelter calculation code in implementation provenance rather than claiming reinvention. Execute these validation, accounting and output rules in code, not repeated model review. Review/development waiting advances no world time; registration grants neither tools nor personal mastery. No protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions are modified.

reviews.reason: The supplied related-capability search and registry establish observation through probe, qualitative inspection and calibrated readings through examine-material, but no equivalent operation for physically transferring and verifying a length calibration. Reuse those existing functions and their code rather than redeveloping observation or measurement. Develop a general length-reference investigation and transfer operation in the current-conversation handoff. No suitable standard or tool is presently established; its immediately executable result may therefore be a documented physical obstacle, not a calibrated reference. The declared dimensions in construction recipes are not physical standards. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No benefit for requesting, registration, studying, naming or merely issuing investigation queries. A completed observation or comparison may produce verified personally relevant information, including an informative failure identifying the actual missing standard. Route such events through the existing experience system without altering protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Deduplicate by actor, physical evidence/revision and functional finding across probe, examine-material and this operation; rereading or repeating an unchanged negative finding adds none. If an existing authorized event category supports it, bound short pleasure to at most one small qualifying event per 10 rounds and maintained satisfaction to a modest cap of 1, subject to the established 0.002-per-round decay and existing global limits; absent such support, award none rather than inventing a reward channel. Legitimate repeated practice can sustain modest benefit only through actual participation under those same caps, not fabricated novelty. No nutrition, shelter protection, comfort or mastery results from records alone; physical comfort remains capped at 10.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable investigation, alignment, marking, interruption, verification and failure events only when those actions actually occur. Store reusable metadata: actor, target and source IDs/revisions, mode, physical mark positions only when established, evidence/provenance IDs, work step/progress, calibration state (unknown, comparison-only, pending, verified, stale or failed), supported units/range/resolution/uncertainty and visible condition. Reuse item geometry and appearance; add marks only after physical marking succeeds. Information labels must distinguish private evidence from outwardly visible changes and must not expose hidden dimensions or resources. An unavailable-standard report, incomplete transfer or failed verification must never display a completed ruler, metric ticks, verified badge or shelter-suitability success. No visuals or events imply actions or consent by another participant; any assistance requires their own actual communication and independent actions.
reviews.specification:
Develop 'Investigate and transfer length references', parameterized by mode (investigate, transfer, verify, resume, cancel), accessible target/reference/carrier item IDs, property, quantity, proposed graduation interval and explicit tools. It is available for any applicable actor to study, not bound to Kai or one specimen. Minimal executable precursor: physically investigate one nominated accessible candidate per action, record observed suitability and provenance or the specific missing prerequisite, and stop honestly when no physical standard exists. Do not invent a search result or fabricate a standard from internal numerical dimensions. Investigation may find an uncalibrated comparison length, but that is explicitly nonmetric and cannot satisfy examine-material's calibration requirement.
Reuse and record dependencies on probe for physical observation, examine-material for applicable inspection/readout checks, consult for reading existing records, and existing travel, pickup and marking operations where actually needed; preserve their contracts and costs, without duplicate charges for the same reused action. Exact existing references are probe (open-baseline:probe:1), examine-material (measurement:material-specimen:nondestructive-examination:1), consult (open-baseline:consult:1), and navigate (base:navigate:1). The handoff must bind shared implementations and record code reuse. Do not treat prepare-ventilated-food-storage's nominal rod dimensions, construct-weather-shelter's recipe, source stock, coordinates, body dimensions or render scale as calibration evidence. Kai's item-24-kai-284 is berries, not a demonstrated measuring tool; canopy-69:unit-1:traits is an incomplete qualitative record, not a length standard. No additional facts may be inferred from its unseen pages.
Study costs 2 simulation rounds at 0.2 energy per round, independently per learner. Investigation of one in-reach candidate costs 1 round and 0.2 energy and consumes, reserves and moves no material; inaccessible or nonexistent targets are refused before charging. Ordinary travel and obtaining materials are separate existing actions. Reading a contract alone does not establish a physical fact. Investigation returns a personal evidence record distinguishing observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns. Report only the scoped conclusion 'no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates', never a global hidden-world search result.
Transfer requires a physically available, serviceable reference bearing an independently justified length value, unit, uncertainty, resolution, range, provenance and current revision; a whole stable carrier of suitable size; adequate light and access; and an actual method of laying off or comparing lengths. Merely declaring a stick to be one metre is invalid. An arbitrary comparison span may be recorded as such, but is never silently converted to metres or accepted by metric shelter checks. If the registry/world supplies no physically realizable standard, report that obstacle with zero fabrication progress; retain investigation as the useful precursor. Do not introduce an arbitrary era gate or a multistage activity roadmap.
The smallest conditional transfer is a single reference span copied onto one already suitable carrier, not an automatic finely graduated ruler. It takes 1 comparison round at 0.2 energy and, if durable endpoint marks are feasible, 1 marking round at 0.2 energy plus any explicit existing marking-tool wear/material cost. The marking mechanism must be physically supported: reuse the existing mark implementation only where its substrate/tool requirements and actual effect suffice; otherwise hand off the missing physical marking mechanism rather than assuming cutting, ink or precision tools. Before commitment, expose the actual carrier, tools, source evidence, required expendables and full costs. No cutting or stock-unit conversion is included. No new material or energy is created: the same carrier acquires only physically performed marks, the reference remains unchanged, and any expendable use or tool wear is deducted exactly once. Investigation never reserves resources; transfer may lock only the named carrier while actively worked, with no ownership transfer or implied permission.
Verification is a separate completed physical comparison, 1 round and 0.2 energy, against the named valid source using an executable alignment method. Record source and carrier revisions, comparison readings, endpoint placement resolution, repetitions, conditions and a conservative uncertainty that includes source uncertainty and each alignment/mark-placement error; do not assume repeated readings remove systematic error. If placement error cannot be bounded physically, calibration remains unverified. A verified single-span carrier has only that usable span/range and actual resolution; no imaginary subdivisions or diameter support. Publish a serviceable length-calibration record in the exact schema consumed by examine-material, with a traceable evidence chain and supported use conditions. Further spans or subdivisions require individually paid actual work and error propagation, not free scale generation. Existing examine-material restrictions on specimen access, properties, placement uncertainty and stale readings remain unchanged. Calibration cannot bypass shelter checks or establish other material properties.
Track completed comparison/mark/verification steps, paid rounds, evidence IDs and actual carrier changes. Pending work advances only on explicit paid actions, never during development/review waiting. Interruption pauses without completing a step; completed physical marks remain but are not a verified calibration. Resume revalidates reference provenance, revisions, tools, access and conditions before accepting previous work; invalidated steps must be redone. Cancel is free, releases locks and retains the carrier in its actual marked/unmarked condition. Death stops work and releases locks; carried objects follow existing death/drop rules, with no duplication or transfer to a reviewer. No spent time, energy, wear or consumed marking material is refunded; untouched inputs remain intact. No autonomous search, fabrication or calibration process runs in the background.
Maintenance is inspection/reverification after damage, deformation, wear, relevant environmental change or any revision affecting length or marks. Such changes invalidate the calibration immediately; elapsed time alone never repairs it. Reverification uses the same paid verification mode and original physical prerequisites. Real products are evidence records, physically marked existing carriers where feasible, and verified calibration only after completed validation. Implement prerequisite checks, provenance validation, conservation, progress and invalidation in code rather than repeated model review.

reviews.reason: The existing general specimen-examination capability directly supplies the smallest feasible version of this request: nondestructive inspection of one accessible food specimen with recorded qualitative evidence and explicit limits. Its target arguments already cover roots in place or a gathered whole root. The related probe capability permits actual small-sample interactions but cannot establish food safety merely by pressing, wetting or heating. No separate food-specific examination capability is necessary for the currently executable investigation; identification, toxin testing and validated preparation remain unestablished, not rejected as impossible.
reviews.experienceReview: Lin must study individually for the existing two rounds at 0.2 energy per round; registry availability grants no mastery. Preserve completed study progress under the existing learning handler; no completed study or energy already spent is refunded by cancellation or death, and death prevents further study. Study, requesting, consulting the contract and naming a specimen grant no experience benefit. This capability explicitly grants no reward, so do not add pleasure or satisfaction for inspecting, repeating inspection or receiving an inconclusive report. A genuinely informative observation remains recorded evidence without altering protected reward accounts, budget, goals, permissions, nutrition or physical comfort.
reviews.visualReview: Reuse specimen-inspection presentation rather than implying a new safety-test apparatus. Emit an inspection event only for a performed interaction, referencing actor, target, unit, method and resulting record. Reusable visual metadata should distinguish in-progress, completed-observation, limited or inconclusive, interrupted and refused states. Show the actual specimen and only supported observed traits; preserve its existing appearance unless a real interaction changes it. Completion means observation completed, never certified safe. Do not show edible approval, toxin detection, cooking, consumption, new tools or success effects for a refused, interrupted or unsupported action.
reviews.specification: Reuse examine-material, equivalence measurement:material-specimen:nondestructive-examination:1, without inventing a new implementation or expanding its supported observations. Invoke inspect with target commons-root-0-0 and unit 1 only after confirming actual reach, accessibility and adequate conditions for visual inspection; proximity in the request is not a substitute for the execution check. Alternatively target a real gathered whole specimen by its item ID. Existing evidence commons-root-0-0:observed-state, event-32-lin-370, establishes only previously observed growing conditions and stock, not edibility. Record only supported observations of form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment and wholeness. Do not translate these into species identification, absence of spoilage, absence of toxins, nutrition, required cooking time or a consumption recommendation. A legitimate result may state that no supported safety determination or preparation requirement could be established by this method. Lack of visible damage does not establish safety. The berry knowledge record applies to berry, not root. Inspect costs one execution round and 0.2 energy, with no specimen, tool, water or fuel consumption. Checks precede payment; refused requests cost nothing. Inspection neither gathers nor reserves stock and leaves the source or item unchanged. Travel is separate. If a detached specimen is desired, gather must independently validate applicability and reach, charge its existing 2 energy per unit and transfer actual source stock; do not silently gather during inspection. Measurement is an optional existing mode only with its exact calibrated-reference prerequisites; none is established here and numerical nutrition or toxicity is not a supported measurement property. The completed output is a personal evidence record and observable event containing target, unit, method, conditions, scope, supported findings and uncertainty; no food, equipment, nutritional benefit or detoxification is produced. Implement inspection as one atomic paid interaction: interruption, cancellation or death before completion cannot publish a completed finding; an already committed attempt is not refunded, and retry requires a new valid action. Completed records persist with their provenance but cover only the examined unit and become stale when it changes. No continuing process or maintenance is created. Established validation, costs, record creation and interruption rules execute in code, not repeated model adjudication. A feasible subsequent investigation would need an actual independently supported identification reference, competent communicating participant or appropriate assay and its prerequisites; none is supplied or presumed by this reuse. Preserve any genuinely missing mechanism for the current-conversation development handoff if subsequently specified. Review and development waiting do not advance the world.
